latest_forecast.target: next observed close; future date not assumed

shap_explanation.space: raw class margins; not probabilities or causal effects
shap_explanation.calibration_note: SHAP explains the uncalibrated tree; displayed probabilities apply temperature separately.

limitations: Backtest probabilities are research estimates, not validated economic edge.
Calendar gaps change forecast horizon; target is the next observed close.
Candidate metrics may cover different rows when a backend fails or lacks classes; inspect observations.
Calibration selects temperature and model on the same block; outer test remains untouched.
Latest classifier predicts categories; it does not estimate a full return distribution.
No costs, execution, position sizing, TFT, DeepSurv, or PPO model is represented.

mlflow.tracking: request-local filesystem; no remote server or persistent history

source.name: Synthetic regime-switching returns

calendar_gaps.interpretation: Weekdays include market holidays; gaps do not by themselves prove missing observations.

source.return_definition: Next-observed-close log return; uploaded prices are assumed consistently adjusted.

normality.interpretation: Jarque–Bera tests normality, not independence. Its asymptotic p-value assumes IID observations; serial dependence can invalidate it.

ols_hac.scope: Full-history in-sample exploratory inference; no out-of-sample forecasting validity claim.

arima.scope: Full-history fitted demonstration. Forecast is unvalidated; excluded from out-of-sample model rankings.
arima.interval_assumptions: Conditional Gaussian ARIMA innovation assumptions; parameter uncertainty omitted.

execution_note: Precomputed by Python on synthetic data; this static site does not run XGBoost, LightGBM, Optuna, SHAP or MLflow.
